experiments.label: Richer Skills briefs
experiments.result_summary: Kept enrich on; click data sparse but blurbs cited timelier hooks.

posthog_snapshot_at_end.note: Formal PostHog experiment not linked; snapshot from imported CSV only.

success.success_criteria: Post-rank web/HN enrichment lifts Skills outbound repo clicks during the treatment window without a material drop in Skills briefing pageviews.

metric.pass_threshold: Treatment window aggregate repo_click (section=skills) ≥ baseline window; qualitative review that Why-now hooks cite enrich sources.

experiments.short_hypothesis: Post rank web enrich lifts Skills outbound repo clicks during the treatment window.

experiments.label: Homepage layout v2
experiments.metric: clicks on today's brief and archive (PostHog)
experiments.result_summary: Shipped layout v2 without completing formal before/after measurement.

success.success_criteria: Homepage layout v2 raises homepage_index_click and index pageviews vs the baseline window without increasing bounce on /index.html or /skills/index.html.

metric.pass_threshold: Treatment aggregate homepage_index_click ≥ baseline aggregate (playbook export).

experiments.short_hypothesis: Homepage layout v2 raises brief and archive clicks without hurting bounce.

experiments.label: Firecrawl for Skills briefs
experiments.metric: shadow rubric specificity, accuracy, timely hooks
experiments.result_summary: Firecrawl provider shipped for Skills web enrich.

success.success_criteria: Firecrawl web enrich matches or beats Jina/HN shadow rubric on specificity, accuracy, and timely hooks on Skills shadow runs.

metric.pass_threshold: Shadow rubric pass on ≥90% of reviewed repos; repo_click (section=skills) tracked as secondary (sparse traffic).

experiments.short_hypothesis: Firecrawl enrich matches or beats shadow rubric on Skills briefs.

experiments.label: Less repeated Skills picks
experiments.metric: consecutive-day top-10 overlap, unique repos, NEW share
experiments.result_summary: Overlap down to 37.5% vs 70% baseline; kept tighter soft dedup.

success.success_criteria: Stronger soft-dedup cuts consecutive-day top-10 overlap by ≥15 percentage points vs the 70% baseline while keeping weekly unique repos and NEW share in the top 10 at or above baseline.

metric.pass_threshold: digest.json mean consecutive-day overlap ≤55% (≥15pp below 70% baseline); PostHog clicks secondary per playbook.

experiments.short_hypothesis: Stronger soft dedup cuts repeat top picks while keeping weekly diversity.

experiments.label: Shorter Skills briefs
experiments.metric: output tokens per repo; shadow rubric pass rate
experiments.result_summary: Treatment cut output about 18% with rubric pass held.

success.success_criteria: Ponytail narration cuts average output tokens per repo by ≥15% vs baseline with rank-1 rubric pass rate ≥95% and Why-now still citing timely hooks.

metric.pass_threshold: Lab token log: ≥15% lower avg output tokens vs baseline (~2005) with rubric pass ≥95%; PostHog series is secondary monitoring.

experiments.short_hypothesis: Tighter Skills narration cuts tokens about 15 percent with rubric pass held.

experiments.label: Less AI-sounding briefs
experiments.result_summary: Kept. Treatment rubric 13 of 13 pass with why now 5.0 and specificity 5.0 vs baseline 3.7 and 4.5; DIGEST_HUMANIZER_POLISH stays on both digests.
experiments.note: Closed 2026-10-24 PT. DIGEST_HUMANIZER_POLISH kept on both OSS and Skills digest commands.

success.success_criteria: Post-narration Humanizer polish improves human-sounding quality on OSS and Skills blurbs without hurting specificity, Why-now, or factual accuracy (editorial rubric + spot-check). Do not gate on PostHog CTR.

metric.pass_threshold: Rubric avg ≥4.0 on specificity, why-now, and accuracy on treatment runs; human-sounding spot-check pass. PostHog daily count is monitoring only.

experiments.short_hypothesis: Humanizer polish makes OSS and Skills blurbs sound more human without losing accuracy.

experiments.label: Digest UI freeze
experiments.metric: avoid confounding caveman token and rubric reads
experiments.note: Baseline observation through 2026-11-08; extension through caveman readout tbd.

success.success_criteria: No digest UI or Pages layout changes during the freeze window so caveman compression and rubric reads stay unbiased.

metric.pass_threshold: Daily homepage_index_click stays within ±25% of baseline average; zero shipped digest_ui changes in git during the window.

experiments.short_hypothesis: No digest UI changes during the freeze so caveman reads stay unbiased.

experiments.label: Shorter enrichment context
experiments.metric: enrich input/output tokens; rank-1 rubric; Why-now rubric

success.success_criteria: DIGEST_ENRICH_COMPRESS lowers enrich input and output tokens vs baseline without dropping rank-1 rubric pass rate or Why-now quality (both editions).

metric.pass_threshold: ≥15% lower avg enrich input tokens vs baseline with rubric pass ≥95%; PostHog repo_click (section=skills) secondary.

experiments.short_hypothesis: Enrich compression lowers token use without dropping rubric pass or Why now quality.

experiments.label: Fresher Why-now on repeats
experiments.metric: Why-now uniqueness on repeat repos; rubric score

success.success_criteria: Why-now memory reduces lexical overlap with prior briefs on repeat repos while keeping why-now rubric score and accuracy at or above baseline.

metric.pass_threshold: Why-now rubric avg ≥4.0 on repeat repos with ≥20% lower hook overlap vs baseline; PostHog clicks secondary.

experiments.short_hypothesis: Why now memory freshens repeat repo hooks while keeping rubric scores up.

experiments.label: Smarter early ranking
experiments.metric: top-10 day-over-day stability during bootstrap weeks
experiments.note: Bootstrap flag values tbd after baseline review.

success.success_criteria: Tighter bootstrap max-stars guards improve list quality and day-over-day top-10 stability during bootstrap-like weeks without hiding real momentum picks.

metric.pass_threshold: Mean consecutive-day top-10 overlap down ≥15pp vs baseline from digest.json; fewer junk mega-repo swings; PostHog secondary.

experiments.short_hypothesis: Bootstrap ranking guards improve early list stability without hiding momentum picks.
